component: Mailto negative assertions and comment accuracy

quotes.text: // 'priority' isn't exposed on nsIMsgCompFields, but from= is the critical

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The negative URL includes priority, but the test directly asserts only from, replyTo and organization. It does not supply followup-to. The comment says priority is not exposed, although the original and fixed scriptable nsIMsgCompFields interface declare it. Correct that concrete comment and add direct expected-result checks for any intended priority/followupTo coverage. Passing these three existing assertions would not verify the omitted properties; no runtime test was run.
title: The mailto negative test omits priority coverage and misstates its interface
